purpose: Extend the one-event Route196 Stage2-L implementation smoke after the preregistered 120-step run learned the dense relevance and two of three language counterfactual gates but did not yet prefer the conservative answer for on-path UQ.

decision_policy.success_means: The implementation can overfit the intended on-path, off-path, and zero-UQ semantics on one event.
decision_policy.failure_means: Inspect conditioning capacity, prompt-family interference, or optimization before changing labels or starting the multi-event LoRA pilot.
